raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Add opt-in MI355X AgentX profiles for [InferenceX #4526](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4526), replacing the stale MI355X agentic guide with two generated presets covering all twelve operating points. Generic defaults, other GPUs/variants, PD configuration and the separate #2792 fixed-sequence recipe remain intact.

**Source qualification caveat:** shared INT4 QuickReduce can lower DSpark draft-activation communication precision relative to the pinned-image default. Both preset runbooks expose this limitation. These opt-in presets document the source configuration; they do not certify InferenceX draft-precision compliance or production qualification. [Current grandfathering policy](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/blob/f58175bd45c343f1bab7bed35f052a7e429935fc/inferencex-e2e/docs/MODELS.md#all-reduce-policy) explicitly preserves draft-precision requirements; no waiver is claimed.

## Claims

- Nine TP8 points use DSpark K6 with opt-in monokernel; three TP1/DP8 points use tensor-sharded experts and session-affine routing, with monokernel disabled.
- Pins the actual source image `vllm/vllm-openai-rocm:nightly-e4a5b5537344b103ed10de7764378ef09604ef3d` and target/tokenizer revision `72e1d3230f6c080a530b0a1d46f8eb4602340597` of `deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813`. No digest was recorded by the source.
- Generated serving/eval commands keep real target verification. Throughput-only synthetic AL **3.77** is a separate runbook overlay from the committed thinking-on K6 golden curve, and does not enter the production commands.

## Validation

Renderer: `vllm-project/recipes@e38b528a540f3bf79674960cae78173e775e7fdc`.

- `node scripts/validate-source.mjs --source vllm --dir ../vllm-4526/recipes`: passed; API build passed, **218 recipes**.
- `pnpm test:presets`, `pnpm test:schema`, `pnpm test:overlay`, `pnpm test:guide-html`: **56/56 passed** with ordinary subprocess access.
- `pre-commit run --files recipes/models/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Pro.yaml`: passed; `git diff --check`: passed.
- Compared **4,096 existing renderings** across all five variants, eligible GPUs, six existing strategies, eight feature combinations, Python/Rust and applicable node counts: **all unchanged**, including deployment, Docker and actual Verify/Bench helper output.
- All **12 engine points** match native bound source argv/environment/image, generated API and Docker output. Actual browser checks covered all twelve cells, Python frontend, real verification, both Verify/Bench popovers, DPA engine8100/router8000, router/runbooks, baseline opt-out and unrelated B200 NVFP4 rendering; zero page/HTTP errors. Router companion differences are explicitly handled in the runbook, not normalized as equivalent. No local GPU inference or performance rerun is claimed.

External GPU evidence (configuration compatibility, **not** draft-precision policy compliance):

- Original [sweep 40260921924, final attempt 3](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/40260921924/attempts/3): API head `882db2060239f4d849f8b1c93f3b8b192ad3637e`; actual CI merge `f301906060dcfd3b63ac6f77a735698f731f65b1`. Native matrix/binder expansion at the actual merge and frozen source head `5ec3c995988e5d3632c1ff53e8ae39da3e799892` gives identical twelve runtime recipes, throughput overlays and two selected eval cases. Actual argv/environment recordings match all twelve bound cases. Ninety-one relevant runtime inputs are identical; other harness differences do not apply to this lane.
- Frozen-head [run 40626241537](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/40626241537) is an authorization skip: performance/eval matrices **did not execute**. [Reuse authorization](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4526#issuecomment-6459765373) does not itself prove equivalence.
- Original logs identify installed vLLM `0.32.1rc1.dev466+ge4a5b5537.rocm100`, DSpark K6, and active target-backbone monokernel. Draft layers use their ordinary path; monokernel can fall back on ineligible steps.

| Arm | Concurrency → max sequences | Successful performance jobs |
|---|---|---|
| TP8 / DP1, monokernel | 1→2, 4→8, 8→16, 16→32, 32→64, 40→80, 48→96, 56→112, 64→128 | [c1](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/40260921924/job/121373182742), [c4](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/40260921924/job/121373182743), [c8](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/40260921924/job/121373182751), [c16](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/40260921924/job/121373182807), [c32](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/40260921924/job/121373182744), [c40](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/40260921924/job/121373182775), [c48 attempt 3](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/40260921924/job/121975825964), [c56](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/40260921924/job/121373182794), [c64 attempt 2](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/40260921924/job/121870097929) |
| TP1 / DP8, no monokernel | 64→64, 128→128, 192→192 | [c64](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/40260921924/job/121373182727), [c128](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/40260921924/job/121373182704), [c192](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/40260921924/job/121373182785) |

| Real-verification GSM8K, 1,319 unique questions per arm | Strict | Flexible | Threshold |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| [TP8, c64](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/40260921924/job/121373182806) | 0.969674 | 0.968916 | 0.91 |
| [TP1/DP8, c192](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/40260921924/job/121373182635) | 0.971948 | 0.971190 | 0.91 |

Both evals use ordinary DSpark verification, GSM8K 5-shot, `--apply_chat_template`, temperature 0 and max output 16384. Each sample artifact has 2,638 lines containing 1,319 doc IDs duplicated twice, not 2,638 unique questions. These results do not establish private agentic accuracy or draft-precision compliance.

The source is not error-free: TP c48 failed host setup in attempts 1/2 before succeeding in attempt 3; TP c64's failed attempt 1 has zero profiled requests and is excluded in favor of successful attempt 2. Selected successful summaries retain request errors within the source validator's 10% limit (TP c16/32/40: one each; c48/56/64: two each; DP c64: one; c192: four). No throughput gain or zero-error claim is made.

**Current integration validation:** the conflict with merged B200 recipe [#64316](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/64316) was resolved without losing either lane: both B200 presets (13 points) and both MI355X presets (12 points) remain under one YAML mapping. Strict source/schema/API validation against renderer `488263c52097ed0a33f2919c140e3824aa82d7c1`, changed-file pre-commit and generated-output preservation passed: all 50 point/frontend renderings and 4,096 existing baseline renderings are unchanged. The earlier global dependency-lock pre-commit failure was fixed by upstream main.

The normal CI command updated the branch to `308e367f21891b42d45342cadbecf5c0d24263e4` and [Buildkite #98377](https://buildkite.com/vllm/ci/builds/98377) passed in 41 seconds. All four required checks (`pre-commit`, `DCO`, `pre-run-check`, `buildkite/ci/pr`) passed on this head. The recipe file is byte-identical to the previously validated `a8ec84ebe36625768e818f00ae2a7a2949fc48bb`; no runtime or recipe change was needed for this CI refresh.

Post-submission independent `golden-review`, refreshed on 2026-10-29, found no additional actionable recipe-fidelity defect. The documented InferenceX source-precision limitation remains unresolved. This assessment concerns the vLLM documentation change and does not grant an InferenceX policy exception or replace maintainer review.

## Details

Authoritative input at frozen head:

- [MI355X AgentX runtime recipe](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/blob/5ec3c995988e5d3632c1ff53e8ae39da3e799892/inferencex-e2e/benchmarks/single_node/srt-slurm-recipes/dsv4/vllm/mi355x-fp4-mtp/agentic.yaml), [matrix/image entry](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/blob/5ec3c995988e5d3632c1ff53e8ae39da3e799892/inferencex-e2e/configs/amd-master.yaml), [K6 golden AL curve](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/blob/5ec3c995988e5d3632c1ff53e8ae39da3e799892/inferencex-e2e/infx/golden_al_distribution/dsv4-pro-0813-dspark.yaml).
- Merged runtime prerequisite: [vLLM #61482](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/61482), merge `139feb45348d3eb303107a896e21303db3a0344e`; supports DSpark with TP8 monokernel, rather than STP-only.
- Published [recipe](https://recipes.vllm.ai/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Pro) / [JSON](https://recipes.vllm.ai/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Pro.json) lack these profiles (observed 2026-10-29 at source `vllm-project/vllm@9a0f9b45df86b91664923ad076f27a50f69c4766`; only B200 presets are published). Canonical ownership is vLLM `recipes/`; no renderer copy or generated output is changed.

Before: no MI355X preset JSON; stale guide used `eed1f3...`, synthetic MTP K3 / AL2.49 and fixed max-seqs8. After: two opt-in preset JSON exports with twelve explicit scheduler limits, real DSpark K6, image e4a5 and TP-only monokernel; synthetic reproduction remains separate. Existing baseline output remains byte-equivalent in the inspected matrix.

**Source precision limitation:** [Current InferenceX CONTRIBUTING](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/blob/f58175bd45c343f1bab7bed35f052a7e429935fc/CONTRIBUTING.md#draft-model-precision) prohibits submission-side lowering of draft activation/computation precision below the pinned image's defaults. Source sets `VLLM_ROCM_QUICK_REDUCE_QUANTIZATION=INT4` versus the image default `NONE`, shared by draft collectives. At TP8, 32 active K6 requests yield at least 192 draft rows; a contiguous BF16 attention-output reduction is 2,752,512 bytes, above the 2 MiB INT4 threshold. Draft layers bypass monokernel, not QuickReduce. The recipe explicitly records this unresolved source-qualification issue; a source correction and qualifying evidence are still needed to establish InferenceX compliance. Passing target evals/synthetic AL is not an exception. No InferenceX edit or compliance sign-off is made here.

Other effective-runtime details:

- Native target and DSpark weights are mixed FP8/MXFP4, KV is FP8. No draft dtype/weight-quantization override or model-architecture override is added. Target/tokenizer revisions are pinned, but source supplies **no separate draft revision**; do not infer one from the target flag.
- The obsolete source env `VLLM_PREFIX_CACHE_RETENTION_INTERVAL=32768` is a no-op in e4a5. It is omitted without adding a CLI override, retaining effective default `0`; converting it to CLI32768 would change behavior.
- `image.pip` records dependencies rather than installing them: runbooks require Pillow/FastAPI/Uvicorn in the same container before the generated engine command. The generic Docker wrapper alone is not a completed setup.
- Existing DPA strategy emits TP1/DP8 and a generic router. Its companion cannot express the source pin/timeout/retry settings, so the runbook provides the exact replacement `vllm-router==0.1.14`, consistent hashing, 14400-second timeout, retries disabled and stable `X-Session-ID`. Serve port8100 and Verify/Bench router port8000 remain consistent.

Duplicate checks found no #4526 equivalent. Same-file [vLLM #64316](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/64316) is separate **B200 / InferenceX #4554** work. Historical [recipes #824](https://github.com/vllm-project/recipes/pull/824) concerns an older FP8 Preview/MTP lane; merged #928/#972/#1053 do not cover these profiles. This does not import the later InferenceX #4578 candidate.

AI assistance was used: Codex reconstructed configurations, audited external evidence, authored the recipe and ran the checks above under the contributor's instruction. The human contributor remains responsible for reviewing, understanding and defending the change; this agent report does not certify that human accountability requirement.

---

- [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR.

- [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples.
- [x] **Pull Request Contents:** Includes a brief summary and relevant links, supports claims with evidence, explains root causes and implementation trade-offs, and follows the contributing guide.
</details>

- `image.pip` records dependencies rather than installing them: runbooks require Pillow/FastAPI/Uvicorn in the same container before the generated engine command. The generic Docker wrapper alone is not a completed setup.
- Existing DPA strategy emits TP1/DP8 and a generic router. Its companion cannot express the source pin/timeout/retry settings, so the runbook provides the exact replacement `vllm-router==0.1.14`, consistent hashing, 14400-second timeout, retries disabled and stable `X-Session-ID`. Serve port8100 and Verify/Bench router port8000 remain consistent.

Duplicate checks found no #4526 equivalent. Same-file [vLLM #64316](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/64316) is separate **B200 / InferenceX #4554** work. Historical [recipes #824](https://github.com/vllm-project/recipes/pull/824) concerns an older FP8 Preview/MTP lane; merged #928/#972/#1053 do not cover these profiles. This does not import the later InferenceX #4578 candidate.

AI assistance was used: Codex reconstructed configurations, audited external evidence, authored the recipe and ran the checks above under the contributor's instruction. The human contributor remains responsible for reviewing, understanding and defending the change; this agent report does not certify that human accountability requirement.

+      for draft collectives too. For example, 32 active K6 requests produce at
+      least 192 draft rows, making the BF16 attention-output reduction eligible
+      for INT4 communication in the pinned image. This conflicts with
+      [InferenceX's draft-precision rule](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/blob/67de4b34ee1419b2a31c0e7200964a6e78015be4/CONTRIBUTING.md#draft-model-precision).

+      qualifying validation; they are not a production recommendation. Real

+      using the pinned image interactively, install these prerequisites inside

+      dependencies in its container before using that launch form.

+      DSpark draft revision. DSpark loads the native draft from the same model ID

+      standard-path target and draft collectives, rather than being target-only.

+      digest. Keep inherited environment settings consistent with the preset.

+      The generated serving commands use real target verification. For the
+      **InferenceX throughput sweep only**, merge the following keys into their
+      speculative config, retaining DSpark K6 and probabilistic drafting:

+      or accuracy evaluation. The generic Bench command is a smoke benchmark,
+      not an AgentX replay; reproduce AgentX with the linked InferenceX harness.

+      The TP8 scheduler caps are twice the listed client concurrency for AgentX
+      fan-out. No host-memory offload is enabled. The source's obsolete
+      `VLLM_PREFIX_CACHE_RETENTION_INTERVAL=32768` has no effect in this image;
+      the presets retain the effective CLI default of `0` (semantic checkpoints).
+
+      Evidence: [sweep 40260921924, attempt 3](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/40260921924/attempts/3)

+      Its actual CI merge `f301906060dcfd3b63ac6f77a735698f731f65b1` and the cited
+      head produce identical native recipe expansion for this lane.
+      This documentation change does not rerun GPU inference or establish private
+      agentic accuracy evaluation.
